svg.title: Every check passes; 73 of 73 core line points are covered
svg.desc: Programs against the Python reference model: 253 pass. 11,928 retired instructions, run in Icarus and Verilator. Invariants checked on 38,603 cycles. 46/46 instruction-class bins hit. Spike, riscv-arch-test 3.10.0: 39/39 tests. 12,720 signature words equal Spike. RV32I suite; not ACT4 and not certification. Random programs against Spike: 50 programs. 16,908 retirements and 5,091 store bytes equal the Spike commit log. Hazard cross bins: 327/327 hit. 108 generated hazard programs. Figure 5 shows every bin. Deliberate RTL bugs caught: 38/38. 8 by invariants, 8 by hazard programs, 7 by Spike tests, 4 by invariants, 11 by invariants. DOT4 lane sweep: 262,144 cases. Every signed byte pair in each lane; checksum equal to the oracle in Verilator and Icarus. Of 1,024 custom-0 encodings only DOT4 executes; the other 1,023 trap. Core line coverage: 100.00%. 73/73 Verilator 5.020 line points in rv32_core.sv. 0 uncovered.
svg.text: Every check passes; 73 of 73 core line points are covered
